verdict.rationale: Kit's V4 API documents a Create Broadcast endpoint to draft or schedule a send to all subscribers or to segment/tag subsets. Update and delete endpoints cover draft and scheduled broadcasts, and the Get endpoint returns the `send_at` schedule, so the full create-and-schedule lifecycle can run through the public API with API-key or OAuth auth. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the scheduling flow works end-to-end without the dashboard (the OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404).
